name: io.github.AnonymousOnyx22/moodle-student-mcp
title: Moodle Student MCP
description: Moodle MCP server for students. Read only access to courses, grades, due dates and announcements.

environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your school's Moodle address, for example https://moodle.myschool.edu

environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your Moodle mobile web service key, copied from Preferences > User account > Security keys
